about: Lists pinned by the record of custom/10-1-presentation-attributes (RGAA test 10.1.2). Names are compared exactly. definedPairs is the record's 'defined pair' table: for each listed attribute, the HTML elements for which HTML 4.01 or the current HTML standard (conforming or obsolete features) defines it. It holds every example the record gives, completed from the attribute index of HTML 4.01 and the HTML standard's lists of conforming and obsolete attributes, as the builder knew them (no source was downloaded). Pairs absent from it give cannot tell, never a fault. height on table, thead, tbody and tfoot: the HTML standard lists them among its obsolete, non-conforming features, so they are defined pairs. Q50 had height on table abstain on the false premise that neither standard lists it; Q59 makes it a fault, as Q57 did for thead, tbody and tfoot. align on fieldset is absent: neither HTML 4.01 nor the HTML standard defines it, so it gives cannot tell under clause (2). Version 1.0.1 removed align on fieldset. Version 1.0.2 added border on input and height on thead, tbody and tfoot (Q57). Version 1.0.3 added height on table (Q59). Pairs listed in exceptedPairs and dimensionPairs are tested first, so their presence in definedPairs never makes them a fault (width and height on source, picture's included, stay cannot tell). color on link is not a defined pair: the record names it among the abstentions.
